summary: Deswell Industries, a Macau-domiciled Nasdaq-listed plastics and electronics manufacturer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) reporting unaudited first-half fiscal 2027 results for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Net sales were $33.0 million, down 0.6% year over year; gross margin fell to 19.8% from 23.4%; operating income was $0.9 million versus $2.5 million; net income was $5.0 million, or $0.31 per diluted share, versus $7.5 million. The board declared a $0.10 per-share first-half cash dividend payable December 23, 2026 to holders of record December 2, 2026. Cash totaled $22.4 million with no borrowings; this is a routine earnings and dividend release, not a special situation.
